Now, Familiar, rejoice! I'll let you drink a special brew made exclusively for you:
Sweepy's Special "Magical Potion"!

I didn't say anything! More importantly, there's still potion
left, so you better drink it properly tomorrow too!

Shut up, that's why I'm in a hurry!
Help out instead of complaining!
Geez, running around like crazy...

Hmph, it's not for you or anything, it's magic practice!
I need to know its effects, so hurry up and drink it.

There's nothing the future Great Witch can't find...
Wait, huh...?!
Alright, let's go!
Magic...?! What are you talking about?!

It seemed that hike up the mountain was to forage for herbs. If it was to prevent
summer fatigue, could she have actually been worried about my health?

As she hugged the plushie and said that, Sweep Tosho's cheeks
seemed to flush red, perhaps illuminated by the fireworks.

Whoa! A huge firework!
Amazing, amazing!

Listen up, Doggo.
While I'm away at training camp, you're in charge of guarding this room—

Come on, search with him!
They're jagged green leaves!

How an Umamusume spends this time of year is crucial,
so I was paying close attention to my health to provide the best training possible.
(Whistle~~~~... BANG!)
A magic juice, huh? In that case, you'll have to go forage in the mountains.

Just then, a giant firework shot up into the sky,
brightly illuminating the nighttime beach.

Oh, that's right, Doggo has to see this too.
Look, look at the awesome fireworks!

Hmph, wrong again.
I told you it's not for my Familiar, didn't I?

The face of the plushie she thrust forward seemed
to plead, "Please just keep watching over her."

Once practice is over, my time is my own, right?!
There's something in the mountains I just HAVE to find—!

*huff*... *pant*... That's all for today, right?!
Well then, I'm heading into the mountains!

Well, duh! I am the future Great Witch, after all.
Of course my potion's effects are going to be top-notch!
*pant*... *pant*... Ughhh, it's so hot!
“Luggage, gather together! Alstroemeria☆”
—Wait, familiar, where are you going?!

Just as Sweep Tosho had warned,
the magical potion tasted downright dreadful!

...What, you want to come too? Hmph,
such a needy little thing. Fine, I'll take you along!

You say that, but you're wheezing and totally out of breath!
If you get in my way, you'll be sorry!

...Then when are YOU going to rest?
Even the puppy thinks so, right?
—Yaaay! Look, familiar, I finally found it!

...You tell me to rest,
while you're running all over the place yourself.

It sure is scorching hot again today.
On days like this, nothing beats having *that*!

It's a magical potion brewed from herbs famous in these parts!
I even cast a spell to ward off summer fatigue on it!
*gulp*... *gulp*... *phew*!
After that, the training camp drills continued on, but—
With the height of summer here, training camp with Sweep Tosho had begun.

Heheh, now my summer camp prep is absolutely flawless!
Look at that, speed-up magic works for packing bags too!

Ugh, jeez, come on! This makes no sense!
They said we'd find it right away once we climbed up~~~!
Not here either... Geez, why isn't it easy to find?!
Haaaaahhh!!

It's definitely got to be here!
I'm Sweepy the Magical Girl, and I'm gonna find it no matter what—

Ever since the break ended, Sweep Tosho
powered through her training menu with incredible focus!

Ahahaha, look at that face, familiar!
Even taking a single lick made me go *blegh*.
After heading down the mountain, I took a stroll by the seaside as told to wait for a while, when—
Just so you know, it's super bitter, so brace yourself!
...What? You look like you want to say something again.
Jeez, why are you following me?! I'm way faster on my own!

Geez, there you are! I've been looking all over for you!
Honestly, you're such a handful!
